trial_court: Court of Additional District Judge, No.1, Nagaur
case_name: Smt. Sarojkanwar W/O Shivraj Bhatt D/O ... vs Shivraj Bhatt S/O Shri Janwrilal @ ...

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Petitioner-wife, Smt. Saroj kanwar W/o Shivraj Bhatt D/o Shri Harisingh
parties.respondent_defendant: Respondent-husband, Shivraj Bhatt S/o Shri Janwrilal @ Joharilal Bhatt

facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife seeks transfer of divorce petition from Court of Additional District Judge, No.1, Nagaur to the Family Court situated at Alwar due to hardship in traveling and lack of male member in her family.

legal_principles.principle: The purpose of the Presidential Order is to carve out and define territorial jurisdiction between the principal seat at Jodhpur and the permanent bench seat at Jaipur.
legal_principles.held: The purpose of the Presidential Order is to carve out and define territorial jurisdiction between the principal seat at Jodhpur and the permanent bench seat at Jaipur. The cases are to be heard accordingly unless the Chief Justice may exercise in his discretion the power vested in him by the proviso to para 2 of the Presidential order.
cited_cases: Rajasthan High Court Advocates Association Vs. Union of India, reported in 2001 (2) SCC 294

legal_principles.principle: In case of a dispute arising whether an individual case or cases should be filed and heard at Jodhpur or Jaipur, the same has to be found out by applying the test-from which district the case arises.
legal_principles.held: In case of a dispute arising whether an individual case or cases should be filed and heard at Jodhpur or Jaipur, the same has to be found out by applying the test-from which district the case arises, that is, in which district the cause of action can be said to have arisen and then exercising the jurisdiction under Article 226 of the Constitution.
cited_cases: Rajasthan High Court Advocates Association Vs. Union of India, reported in 2001 (2) SCC 294
Nasiruddin Vs. State Transport Appellate Tribunal reported in AIR 1976

outcome.final_order: Transfer of Divorce Petition bearing No.24/2019 from the Court of Additional District Judge, No.1, Nagaur to the Family Court situated at Alwar.

use_for_drafting: representing clients in Hindu marriage disputes
